evidence: decorative_mascot: In seg0:start to seg0:end and seg2:end Data stands on a ladder pointing at the top bar. In seg3:start to seg4:end he just perches on top of a circle. He never makes a bar rise or a circle grow.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg3:start, mid and end there are two identical teal circles, both labelled 'Billionaire wealth 127%', under the title 'billionaires wealth vs stock market'. The narration says the S&P grew 195 percent, but no 195% and no S&P label appear anywhere.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison machine got the billionaire series twice instead of billionaires plus the S&P 500, so it draws one number twice and only scales the circles.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show two different quantities: billionaire wealth +127% next to the S&P 500 +195%, each correctly labelled. Make the S&P mark visibly overtake or outgrow the billionaire mark, and have Data cause that motion, for example by pumping up or stacking the S&P side, so the viewer sees that most of the gain is just the stock market.
